# Components

<!-- Generated by scripts/components-index.ts from the packages and the stories. Run `bun run components` to rewrite it; never edit it by hand. -->

Every exported component in the six sokkel-ui packages, by package and area: the path an app
imports it by, what it is (the first sentence of its doc comment) and a story that shows it. Look
here before building any UI part in an app; a part that is close but not right gets an option in
the library, never a local copy.

A row is one module. Its first name is the main component; the others are the parts it exports
with it, imported from the same path. Hooks are under `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/hooks/*` and helpers
under `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/lib/*`; the chart kinds and the fields they read are in `docs/charts.md`.

Every app has the same frame: `Shell` with a `Rail` of its places, the command palette on ⌘K or
Ctrl+K through `Shell`'s `palette` (`placeCommands` and `appearanceCommands` in
`@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/lib/commands`), an `AccountMenu` in the rail's foot, `local` until the
app has sign-in, and a `StatusLine` as the shell's `foot`. A screen adds its own palette groups
while it is mounted with `useCommands` (`hooks/use-commands`), and binds its keys with
`useShortcuts` (`hooks/use-shortcuts`), which `ShortcutsDialog` lists; `useOverlay`,
`useScrollMemory` and `useReducedMotion` are in `hooks/` too. In a desktop window with its title
bar hidden, `Shell`'s `desktop` makes the top strip the window's drag region and leaves room for
the window's buttons (`lib/desktop`).
The look is kept and worn by `useAppearance` and `useScheme` (`hooks/use-appearance`,
`hooks/use-scheme`), with the option lists in `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/lib/appearance`.
Other state an app keeps across reloads goes through `useStored` (`hooks/use-stored`), and files
being uploaded through `useUploads` (`hooks/use-uploads`), which feeds `AttachmentList`.
What plays is told to the operating system (media keys, lock screen) by `useMediaSession`
(`@winterop-com/sokkel-ui-media/use-media-session`), beside `MediaBar`. A queue, its play order,
shuffle and repeat are held by `useQueue` (`use-queue`) over the pure helpers in `queue`; a book
over several files maps its timeline to a file with `timeline`, and LRC lyrics are read by
`parseLyrics` in `lrc`, all under `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui-media/`.

- [`@winterop-com/sokkel-ui`](#winterop-com-sokkel-ui): 214 modules
- [`@winterop-com/sokkel-ui-charts`](#winterop-com-sokkel-ui-charts): 13 modules

| **StatusLine**, StatusItem | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/StatusLine` | What the shell's foot strip says for the screen: a short note at the left and identifiers at the right, on one row of fixed height. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-status-line--tones) |
| **SubNav** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/SubNav` | The second column beside the rail: what the app's section holds, such as a tree of folders, a section's pages or a month to pick a day from. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-sub-nav--folders) |
| **TableOfContents** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/TableOfContents` | An "on this page" list beside a long page or form: its headings, the deeper ones indented, the one the reader is in marked with a bar, each with an optional mark such as a part's state. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-docs--callout) |
| **ThemePicker** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/ThemePicker` | The appearance controls an app's settings show: the named theme, dark or light, the density, the corners, the typeface and the motion. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/themes-theme-picker--basic) |
| **ThemeToggle** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/ThemeToggle` | The light and dark switch for a top bar: the icon shows the scheme in use, and the name and tooltip say what a press does. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-activity--top-bar-menu) |
| **TopBar** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/TopBar` | What the shell's top bar holds: the trail to the current screen at the left, the search that opens the command palette, and the screen's actions at the right. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/charts-area--single) |

| **Inspector**, InspectorSection | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Inspector` | The panel beside a list that shows the chosen row: a header naming the thing (its name, then its code in the code face with a copy button), the thing's actions, then titled sections. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/graphs-run--running) |
| **PageHeader** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/PageHeader` | A page's title, its code under it in the code face, and its actions at the right with the primary one last. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-page-header--title) |
| **PaneHeader** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/PaneHeader` | The strip across the top of a pane, with a rule under it: the pane's title, controls before it such as a back button, and actions at its right end. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-pane-header--plain) |
| **Section**, Surface | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Section` | A titled part of a page. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-sections--flat) |
| **Stack**, Row, Center, Columns, Split, Fill | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Layout` | Cells one under the other, each as wide as the stack. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/media-audio-player--slider) |
| **Toolbar**, ToolbarTitle | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Toolbar` | The row of tools above a page's or a pane's content: a search, filters, a `Segmented`, a sort, a count. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-toolbar--page) |
| **Unfoldable** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Unfoldable` | A heading that opens what is under it. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-states--read) |
| **WindowedPane**, WindowedPaneButton | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/WindowedPane` | Any pane, with a way to open the same content near full screen: an expand button at its top right corner (shown while the pointer is over it, always on touch) opens a window with a margin all round, a title and a close button; Escape closes it too. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-windowed-pane--closed) |

| **SaveBar** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/SaveBar` | The bar pinned to the foot of a page while its edits are not yet saved: how many there are at the left, Discard and Save at the right. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-access--secret) |
| **Search**, SearchResultBody, SearchPreview, SearchGroupHeading | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Search` | The one search for a page, built on `SearchField`: as words are typed the app's `search` is asked, and its results open in a popover under the field, grouped by kind, each with its thumbnail or icon, its title with the query's words marked and a line under it. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-search--open) |

| **SecretReveal** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/SecretReveal` | A secret shown once, as it is created: an API token, a signing key, a recovery code. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-access--secret) |

| **SliderField** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/SliderField` | A number chosen on a slider, its value written out in figures so the setting reads without dragging. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/primitives-inputs-slider-field--plain) |

| **ConfirmCard** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/ConfirmCard` | An action an assistant holds until a person answers: what it will do in a sentence, the call in the code face, and Approve and Deny. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-assistant-reply--card) |

| **ListSkeleton**, Pending | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Loading` | The shape of a list before its rows arrive: rows of uneven length with a short value at the end, or a grid of cards. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-feedback--banners) |
| **LoadingBar**, PageProgress, LoadingOverlay | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Loaders` | A thin bar for a wait: filled to `value` (0 to 100) when the progress is known, a sliding segment when it is not. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-loading--bars) |
| **PageState** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/PageState` | The states a read lands in, kept distinct all the way to the screen: loading, failed, empty, and the content. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-states--read) |
| **Problem** | `@winterop-com/sokkel-ui/Problem` | Something that went wrong, said for a person: what happened in one sentence, then where and what a right value looks like, with machine words marked by backticks drawn in the code face. | [story](https://winterop-com.github.io/sokkel-ui/?path=/story/patterns-feedback--banners) |
